participant_id.Description: BIDS subject label. Original project code with zero-padded number (M5 -> sub-M05; controls MC9 -> sub-MC09).

age.Description: Age in completed years at the first assessment (T1). Patients: computed from date of birth and T1 assessment date (the clinical team confirmed the dates are reliable; this corrects the AGE column of the clinical database for three patients). Controls: demographic sheet.

birth_date.Description: Date of birth (ISO 8601). Identifying information; available for patients only.

education_level.Description: Educational level (NIVEL EDUCATIVO of the demographic sheet), ordinal coding confirmed by the clinical team.

has_t1.Description: At least one valid EEG recording at T1.

has_t2.Description: At least one valid EEG recording at T2.

inclusion_date_t1.Description: Date of inclusion / first assessment (ISO 8601). Identifying information.

inclusion_date_t2.Description: Date of the follow-up assessment (ISO 8601). Identifying information.

interval_days_t1_t2.Description: Days between the T1 and T2 assessment dates (inclusion_date_t2 - inclusion_date_t1).

intervention_weeks.Description: Duration of the intervention between T1 and T2 (column T.INTERVENCION of the clinical database). It is in weeks, not months (about 12-week intervention); the T1-T2 interval is interval_days_t1_t2.

edss_t1.Description: Expanded Disability Status Scale at T1 (0-10).

edss_t2.Description: Expanded Disability Status Scale at T2 (0-10).

dfis_t1.Description: Daily Fatigue Impact Scale (D-FIS) at T1; also available for controls.

dfis_t2.Description: Daily Fatigue Impact Scale (D-FIS) at T2.

bdi_t1.Description: Beck Depression Inventory II at T1; also available for controls.

bdi_t2.Description: Beck Depression Inventory II at T2.

edss_group.Description: Disability category used in the cross-sectional analysis (clinical team classification).

dfis_group_t1.Description: Fatigue category at T1 from the median D-FIS T1 of all patients (cross-sectional sample). Ties with the median go to the upper category. Secondary/exploratory analyses only: primary analyses use continuous D-FIS.

Levels.high: D-FIS at or above the median (ALTA)

dfis_group_long_t1.Description: Fatigue category at T1 within the clinical follow-up cohort (patients with D-FIS at T1 and T2, regardless of EEG quality control), from that cohort's median D-FIS T1. Longitudinal EEG analyses use the subset with has_t2. Ties with the median go to the upper category. Secondary/exploratory analyses only: primary analyses use continuous D-FIS.

Levels.high: D-FIS at or above the median (ALTA)

dfis_group_long_t2.Description: Fatigue category at T2 within the clinical follow-up cohort, from that cohort's median D-FIS T2 (T1 and T2 medians are computed separately). Ties with the median go to the upper category. Secondary/exploratory analyses only: primary analyses use continuous D-FIS.

Levels.high: D-FIS at or above the median (ALTA)

fatigue_response.Description: Fatigue response in the clinical follow-up cohort: D-FIS reduction (dfis_t1 - dfis_t2) compared with the median reduction. Ties with the median go to the upper category. Secondary/exploratory analyses only: primary analyses use continuous D-FIS.

Levels.greater: Reduction at or above the median (MAYOR)

dfis_group_t1_orig.Description: Original cross-sectional fatigue category (median of all patients with T1). Original classification sent by the clinical team (2026-09-10), kept for traceability; superseded by the column without _orig.

dfis_group_t1t2_orig.Description: Original longitudinal fatigue category at T1 (median of patients with T1 and T2). Original classification sent by the clinical team (2026-09-10), kept for traceability; superseded by the column without _orig.

fatigue_response_orig.Description: Original fatigue response between T1 and T2. Original classification sent by the clinical team (2026-09-10), kept for traceability; superseded by the column without _orig.
